fraud_cases.description: 15 checks ranging $8,500–$9,950 submitted across 3 linked accounts over 14 days. Each individual check passes Tier 1 rules. Combined pattern indicates deliberate structuring to avoid $10,000 CTR reporting threshold.
fraud_cases.regulatory_ref: 31 CFR 1010.314 - Structuring transactions to evade reporting requirements

fraud_cases.description: 10 checks with field mismatches detected by Document Intelligence. Amount in words does not match numeric amount, or payee name on image differs from submitted payee. Tier 1 catches these via MICR and field extraction validation.

5 accounts built using synthetic identities (real SSN fragments + fabricated details). Accounts seasoned for 3-9 months with small legitimate-looking transactions. Now escalating check amounts in a bust-out pattern. Accounts share payees and are behaviorally linked. Each account passes individual KYC checks. Only cross-account reasoning reveals the fraud ring.
fraud_cases.regulatory_ref: BSA/AML - Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filing required
